subject: Chinese

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Master phonemic awareness, pronunciation of initials, finals, tones and hanzi
activities.learning_activity: (a) Listen to and pronounce Chinese initials
suggested_methods: Listen and imitate: Guide students to fluently pronounce Chinese initials loudly (e.g., b, p, m, f, d, t, l)
Sing and pronounce: Guide students to pronounce Chinese initials while singing and enjoying their pronunciation
Digital methods: Guide students to listen to initials on audio devices (e.g., CD, speaker or television)
activities.assessment_criteria: Chinese initials have been heard and pronounced
suggested_resources: Initial cards, letter cards, audio transcripts, motion pictures, tianzige

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Master phonemic awareness, pronunciation of initials, finals, tones and hanzi
activities.learning_activity: (b) Read and write Chinese initials
suggested_methods: Use initial cards: Guide students to fluently read the cards shown to them (read the initial on the card and write that initial, preferably writing each initial more than 5 times)
Games: Guide students to find hidden initial cards, and the person who finds the card should read and write it (be praised by fellow students)
Competitions: Lead students to compete in reading initial fluency and spelling
activities.assessment_criteria: Chinese initials have been fluently read and written

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Master phonemic awareness, pronunciation of initials, finals, tones and hanzi
activities.learning_activity: (c) Listen to and pronounce basic Chinese finals
suggested_methods: Listen and repeat: Guide students to carefully listen to the finals produced by the teacher or audio devices and correctly repeat pronouncing the finals they heard
Listen and sing: Guide students to fluently listen to and sing final songs (each student sings a final song)
activities.assessment_criteria: Chinese finals have been pronounced and heard

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Master phonemic awareness, pronunciation of initials, finals, tones and hanzi
activities.learning_activity: (d) Read and write basic Chinese finals
suggested_methods: Use final cards: Guide students to fluently read the cards shown to them (read the final on the card and write the final, preferably writing each initial more than 5 times)
Games: Guide students to find hidden letter cards, and the person who finds the card should read and write it
Competition: Lead students to compete in reading fluency and writing finals
activities.assessment_criteria: Chinese finals have been read and written

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Master phonemic awareness, pronunciation of initials, finals, tones and hanzi
activities.learning_activity: (e) Identify Chinese tones in pronunciation and writing
suggested_methods: Careful listening: Guide students to carefully listen to Chinese tones read by the teacher while students identify them
Reading aloud: Guide students to fluently read tones, with the teacher showing tone actions (rising and falling) and writing down the tones
activities.assessment_criteria: Chinese tones in pronunciation and writing have been identified

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Master phonemic awareness, pronunciation of initials, finals, tones and hanzi
activities.learning_activity: (f) Write Chinese hanzi with one to two strokes
suggested_methods: Dictation: Guide students to write Chinese hanzi with one to two strokes
activities.assessment_criteria: Chinese hanzi with one to two strokes have been written

activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Connect words and objects in the environment
activities.learning_activity: (a) Identify names of various objects found in the classroom and school environment
suggested_methods: Instant questioning: Guide students to answer instant questions about various items found in the classroom (e.g., blackboard, desk, pen)
Design environment: Guide students to design the classroom environment and identify things that should be in the classroom
activities.assessment_criteria: Names of various objects found in the classroom and school environment have been clearly defined
suggested_resources: Classroom picture, real objects, word cards, audio transcripts, motion pictures, sound recorder and tianzige

activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Connect words and objects in the environment
activities.learning_activity: (b) Identify various behaviors taking place in the classroom and school environment
suggested_methods: See and do: Guide students to identify actions taking place in the classroom (e.g., sitting, standing, writing, raising a hand to ask a question, etc.)
Small groups: Lead students in small groups to identify various actions taking place in the classroom
Role play: Lead students to role play actions taking place in the classroom (e.g., teaching, asking a question, etc.)
activities.assessment_criteria: Various actions taking place in the classroom and school environment have been identified

activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Connect words and objects in the environment
activities.learning_activity: (c) Read names and actions defined in the classroom environment
suggested_methods: Games: Guide students to read names using games such as looking for hidden cards in the classroom and identifying the actions of those cards
Digital method: Guide students to use television, computers, tablets to identify actions defined in the classroom
activities.assessment_criteria: Names and actions defined in the classroom environment have been read

activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Connect words and objects in the environment
activities.learning_activity: (d) Write names and actions defined in the classroom environment using pinyin
suggested_methods: Dictation: Lead students to write names and actions identified in the classroom (e.g., teacher mentions an action and students write the name of that action)
activities.assessment_criteria: Names and actions defined in the classroom environment have been written using pinyin

activities.specific_competence: 1.3 Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (a) Introduce oneself using simple sentences
suggested_methods: Games: The teacher beats the drum, students pass a flower around, when the teacher stops beating the drum the student holding the flower will stand up and introduce themselves
activities.assessment_criteria: Simple sentences have been used in self-introduction
suggested_resources: Tianzige, computer, pictures and real objects, picture of people introducing each other, and picture of a person reading a clock and real objects

activities.specific_competence: 1.3 Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (b) Read and write words used in self-identification
suggested_methods: Reading text: Students read text and write (the text should carry a self-introduction message)
activities.assessment_criteria: Words used in self-introduction have been read and written

activities.specific_competence: 1.3 Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (c) Describe different times (e.g., morning, afternoon, evening, etc.)
suggested_methods: Pictures and descriptions: Guide students to look at pictures and identify the times of those pictures
activities.assessment_criteria: Different times have been identified

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate understanding of information in conversation and writing
activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Show appropriate response in familiar communicative contexts
activities.learning_activity: (a) Listen to and follow simple instructions/directions given in the school environment
suggested_methods: Role play: Prepare a short play related to the school context (teacher and student)
activities.assessment_criteria: Simple instructions/directions given in the school environment have been listened to and followed
suggested_resources: Tianzige, pictures and real objects

activities.specific_competence: 3.1 Demonstrate understanding of basic features of spoken and written language
activities.learning_activity: (a) Use tones accurately in simple communication
suggested_methods: Listening and understanding exercise: Use listening and understanding exercises where students must listen to sounds and understand the meaning of sentences pronounced with the correct tone. This will help them understand the impact of tone on sentence meaning

Self-expression exercise: Encourage students to use the correct tone during self-expression. You can provide exercises on common things that need the correct tone, asking them to express themselves using appropriate words and sentences
Use digital resources, such as mobile apps focusing on improving language tone skills.
activities.assessment_criteria: Tones have been used correctly in simple communication
suggested_resources: Pictures and real objects

activities.specific_competence: 3.1 Demonstrate understanding of basic features of spoken and written language
activities.learning_activity: (b) Use punctuation marks correctly when writing simple texts (uppercase letters, lowercase letters, full stop, comma, exclamation mark, and question mark)
suggested_methods: Explanations and examples: Lead students through detailed explanations and give examples of the correct use of punctuation marks, such as uppercase letters (大写字母), lowercase letters (小写字母), full stop (句号), ellipsis/comma (省略号), question mark (问号), and exclamation mark (感叹号). Explain how each mark is used in writing and provide examples of writing words or sentences involving those marks
Proofreading and correction: When students submit their work, proofread and correct their punctuation usage. Provide accurate feedback and guidance to help them improve usage
activities.assessment_criteria: Punctuation marks have been used correctly in writing simple texts
suggested_resources: Tianzige, picture of people introducing each other and real objects

activities.specific_competence: Develop phonemic awareness of Chinese initials, finals, and tones and master pronunciation
activities.learning_activity: (a) Listen to and pronounce syllables consisting only of finals
suggested_methods: Listen and repeat: Guide students to listen to and repeat the text fluently
activities.assessment_criteria: The sounds consisting only of finals are listened to and pronounced
suggested_resources: Texts with finals, and audio recorders with finals

activities.specific_competence: Develop phonemic awareness of Chinese initials, finals, and tones and master pronunciation
activities.learning_activity: (b) Listen to and write syllables consisting only of finals
suggested_methods: Listen and write: students listen to and write finals using digital tools
activities.assessment_criteria: The sounds consisting only of finals are listened to and written

activities.specific_competence: Develop phonemic awareness of Chinese initials, finals, and tones and master pronunciation
activities.learning_activity: (c) Identify new words consisting of syllables only
suggested_methods: Games: Guide students in small groups to identify words with sounds consisting only of finals
activities.assessment_criteria: Words with sounds consisting only of finals are identified

activities.specific_competence: Develop phonemic awareness of Chinese initials, finals, and tones and master pronunciation
activities.learning_activity: (d) Write Chinese characters within three to four strokes
suggested_methods: Project work: Guide students in groups in project work by writing Chinese characters with three to four strokes
activities.assessment_criteria: Chinese characters with three to four strokes are written

activities.specific_competence: Relate words to objects in the environment
activities.learning_activity: (a) Identify names of objects found in the home environment using newly specified words
suggested_methods: Creating a simulated environment: Guide students to design a home environment and identify the names of objects found at home

Brainstorming: Set up a list of words that have the same or similar phonemes or pronunciations as other words, ask students to discover those similar words and explain how their differences are interpreted in meaning, ask students to talk about how they hear or pronounce each word and compare it with another word
activities.assessment_criteria: Names of objects found in the home environment are identified using new words
suggested_resources: Pictures and real objects

activities.specific_competence: Relate words to objects in the environment
activities.learning_activity: (b) Identify various actions taking place in the home environment
suggested_methods: Creating a simulated environment: Guide students to design a home environment and identify various actions taking place

Concentric circles: In teaching language skills, we can have students walk around their environment and identify different items around them. Then, we can encourage them to describe them using correct Chinese vocabulary
activities.assessment_criteria: Various actions taking place in the home environment are identified

activities.specific_competence: Relate words to objects in the environment
activities.learning_activity: (c) Read names and various actions found in the home environment
suggested_methods: Narratives: Students narrate the environment found at home
activities.assessment_criteria: Names and various actions found in the home environment are read

activities.specific_competence: Relate words to objects in the environment
activities.learning_activity: (d) Write names and various actions found in the home environment
suggested_methods: Dictation: Students mention names or actions and write them down in Chinese
Writing competition: Guide students to compete in writing home names or actions, whoever writes the most names and fluently is the winner
activities.assessment_criteria: Various actions found in the home environment are written

activities.specific_competence: Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (a) Introduce family members and friends using simple sentences
suggested_methods: Debate: Guide students to have a discussion about the conditions of their friends and families
activities.assessment_criteria: Family members and friends are introduced using simple sentences
suggested_resources: Pictures and real objects

activities.specific_competence: Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (b) Read and write words used to introduce family members and friends
suggested_methods: Demonstration method: Use a practical example to show how grammar is used. Example: Show students how to form a correct sentence using the word “喜欢”. Students will be asked to create sentences like “我喜欢吃水果” or “他喜欢读书”
activities.assessment_criteria: Words used to introduce family members and friends are read and written

activities.specific_competence: Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (c) Use simple grammar and vocabulary to identify different times (Example: days of the week)
suggested_methods: Questions and answers: (e.g. “when is today” the student answers)
Narratives: Guide students to narrate events and times occurring within a week
activities.assessment_criteria: Different times are identified

activities.main_competence: Demonstrate understanding of information in conversation and writing
activities.specific_competence: Read and understand simple texts
activities.learning_activity: (b) Read and understand instructions presented using a single word
suggested_methods: Reading aloud: Guide students to read words with instructions and enable students to understand those instructions

activities.main_competence: Demonstrate understanding of information in conversation and writing

suggested_methods: Games: Guide students to use simple vocabulary in giving and responding to simple instructions in various games

activities.main_competence: Demonstrate understanding of information in conversation and writing
activities.specific_competence: Show proper response in a familiar communicative context
activities.learning_activity: (a) Listen to and follow simple instructions given in the home environment
suggested_methods: Think-write-pair-share: Write a few words on a paper about the lesson topic. Ask students to think about those words and write down anything that comes to their mind about those words

activities.specific_competence: Speak in various contexts using appropriate grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (a) Make simple conversations using fluent language in the school and home context

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Master phonological awareness of Chinese initials, finals and tones and master pronunciation
activities.learning_activity: (a) Listen to and pronounce syllables composed of finals and initials
suggested_methods: Games: Use games such as Bingo or Shuffle Dice to teach phonological awareness and pronunciation of initials, finals, and tones. For example, you can write a letter on shuffle dice and ask students to say words starting or ending with that letter, and you can also use games like 'Word Guessing Puzzle' to help students connect words to objects in the environment
activities.assessment_criteria: Syllables formed by consonants and vowels have been listened to and pronounced fluently
suggested_resources: Pictures, realia, speakers and audio recorders

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Master phonological awareness of Chinese initials, finals and tones and master pronunciation
activities.learning_activity: (b) Listen to and write syllables composed of finals and initials
suggested_methods: Project work: Divide students into groups to listen to and write down the alphabet/vowels
activities.assessment_criteria: Consonants and vowels based on tones have been listened to and written fluently

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Master phonological awareness of Chinese initials, finals and tones and master pronunciation
activities.learning_activity: (c) Identify words consisting of syllables formed by finals and initials
suggested_methods: Investigation: Give students words and identify the letters and consonants in those words
activities.assessment_criteria: Pronunciations of words consisting of initials and syllables have been identified fluently

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Master phonological awareness of Chinese initials, finals and tones and master pronunciation
activities.learning_activity: (d) Write Chinese characters within five to six strokes
suggested_methods: Dictation: Students read and write new vocabulary containing up to five or six strokes
Shuffling: Shuffle cards/pieces of paper, students select six to form a puzzle

Role play: Lead students in a short game in the classroom to recognize the names of different things (the teacher can buy some items available in the market)

suggested_methods: Role play: Lead students in a short game in the classroom on how to recognize the names of different things (the teacher should buy some items available in the market)

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate understanding of information in dialogue and writing
activities.specific_competence: 2.2 Read and understand simple texts
activities.learning_activity: (a) Read and understand the information expressed in simple sentences
suggested_methods: Stories: Lead students to read short stories
Images and descriptions: Access images with descriptions to improve comprehension
activities.assessment_criteria: Information expressed in simple sentences is read and understood
suggested_resources: Word cards, audio texts, movies, tianzi grids, and additional content for Chinese classes

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate understanding of information in dialogue and writing
activities.specific_competence: 2.3 Respond correctly in familiar conversational contexts
activities.learning_activity: (a) Listen to and follow simple instructions given in a hospital environment
suggested_methods: Demonstration method: Use a practical example to show how grammar is used, for example: Show students how to use "生病"
activities.assessment_criteria: Simple instructions given in a hospital environment are listened to and followed
suggested_resources: Audio texts, movies, tianzi grids, and additional content for Chinese classes

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate understanding of information in dialogue and writing
activities.specific_competence: 2.4 Read various simple texts correctly
activities.learning_activity: (a) Read aloud various phrases paying attention to tones
suggested_methods: Songs: Guide students to sing songs with simple Chinese messages to develop their tone expression skills
activities.assessment_criteria: Tones used in texts are easy to read and clearly defined
suggested_resources: Consonants, flashcards, audio transcripts, and movies

activities.specific_competence: 3.1 Speak in various settings using appropriate grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (a) Have simple conversations using fluent language in a hospital setting
suggested_methods: Role play: Guide students to role-play in a hospital scenario and present it to classmates
activities.assessment_criteria: Fluent communication is conducted using fluent language in a hospital setting
suggested_resources: Photos and real objects

activities.specific_competence: 3.2 Communicate in writing in different contexts using appropriate grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (a) Write short essays about market and hospital environments
suggested_methods: Dictation: Guide students in short dictations within a hospital environment
Writing worksheets: Use writing worksheets to help students correctly write texts related to hospitals and markets
activities.assessment_criteria: Short texts relating to market and hospital backgrounds are written
suggested_resources: Photos and hospital records

translation_note: English rendering of the Kiswahili TIE syllabus, for English-medium schools. Not TIE's own wording — see translation_of for the verbatim source.
